metadata.title: Acme Health Patient Intake API - governed (HIPAA Security Rule)

components.title: Acme Health Patient Intake API (governed)
components.description: The cgep-app-starter Patient Intake API (API Gateway HTTP API, Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, VPC) wrapped with a HIPAA-oriented GRC baseline: customer-managed KMS keys, hardening for GAP-01 through GAP-05, GAP-07 and GAP-08, a multi-region CloudTrail trail, an S3 Object Lock evidence vault, Rego policies enforced by Conftest, and a GitHub Actions pipeline that plans, gates, applies on merge to main, signs evidence with Cosign, and uploads it to the vault. GAP-06 is deferred.
components.purpose: Process patient intake submissions containing ePHI in an audit-defensible way, with continuous signed evidence that the controls stay in place.

control-implementations.description: HIPAA Security Rule implementation. NIST SP 800-66 Rev. 2 (Implementing the HIPAA Security Rule) is the catalog source, since no official OSCAL catalog exists for HIPAA. Each implemented requirement carries its 45 CFR 164 citation in the hipaa-citation prop. Evidence links reference pipeline run 38632599567 (commit 86b36db), the latest signed run when this component was authored.

implemented-requirements.description: ePHI at rest is encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key (aws_kms_key.phi) with automatic annual rotation. The uploads bucket uses SSE-KMS with that key and S3 bucket keys (GAP-01). The DynamoDB submissions table uses server-side encryption with the same key (GAP-02). The Lambda role may use the key only for kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey. Policies hipaa.gap01_uploads_cmk and hipaa.gap02_dynamodb_cmk fail the pipeline if either data store falls back to an AWS-owned or AWS-managed key.

links.text: Cosign-signed pipeline evidence bundle for run 38632599567.

implemented-requirements.description: ePHI in transit is protected. The uploads bucket policy, authored as data.aws_iam_policy_document.uploads_tls so its content is verifiable at plan time, denies all S3 actions for all principals when aws:SecureTransport is false (GAP-03). The intake Lambda runs in the starter VPC's private subnets, which have no internet route; S3 and DynamoDB traffic stays on the AWS network through gateway endpoints, and the function's security group allows only HTTPS egress to those endpoints' prefix lists (GAP-05). Enforced by hipaa.gap03_uploads_tls and hipaa.gap05_lambda_vpc.

links.text: Cosign-signed pipeline evidence bundle for run 38632599567.

implemented-requirements.description: Retrievable copies of ePHI are maintained. Versioning is enabled on the uploads bucket so overwritten or deleted objects are recoverable (GAP-04), and point-in-time recovery is enabled on the DynamoDB submissions table with a 35-day restore window. Versioning is enforced by hipaa.gap04_uploads_versioning; point-in-time recovery was deployed by the pipeline through the green pull request and is not yet policy-enforced.

links.text: Cosign-signed pipeline evidence bundle for run 38632599567.

implemented-requirements.description: Access to ePHI is limited to what the intake function requires. The Lambda role's inline policy, authored as data.aws_iam_policy_document.lambda_inline, grants only dynamodb:PutItem on the submissions table, s3:PutObject under uploads/ in the uploads bucket, and kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey on the PHI key, replacing the starter's dynamodb:* and s3:* (GAP-07). Pipeline access is split into a pull-request role with read-only access and a main-branch-only apply role that is explicitly denied use of the PHI key and Object Lock retention bypass. Enforced by hipaa.gap07_lambda_least_privilege.

links.text: Cosign-signed pipeline evidence bundle for run 38632599567.

implemented-requirements.description: Activity in systems containing ePHI is recorded and examinable. API Gateway access logs (request metadata only, never request bodies) go to a CloudWatch log group with 365-day retention, and the stage is throttled (GAP-08; WAF deferred). A multi-region CloudTrail trail with log file validation records management events to a dedicated, versioned, TLS-only bucket. Every merge to main produces a Cosign-signed evidence bundle stored in an S3 Object Lock vault (GOVERNANCE mode, 60-day retention) encrypted with a dedicated evidence key. Access logging and throttling are enforced by hipaa.gap08_api_logging.
